summary: First full run on the Franceman live chat. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests passed (widget session/identify/messages/end, keyword and AI (Claude) answers, offline message sent once, role security 401/403/409, assign rules, close/reopen, search, visitors, analytics, settings, and the visitor and agent WebSockets: typing preview, page tracking, agent typing, instant reply, AI stops after an agent replies). Frontend (Playwright): public site plus widget, prechat validation, quick-answer chips, AI reply, admin sign-in with a Clerk ticket, session kept after refresh, live inbox, visitor details (country/page history/device), live typing preview, agent typing in the widget, reply, Resolve/Reopen, chat-ended banner and new conversation, assign select, status toggle (widget goes offline/online), /visitors live typing and page updates, analytics, team (last-admin 409 toast), settings save persists, embed snippet, pending screen, sign-out, mobile 390px (full-screen widget, bottom nav, list/thread switching, info sheet). One real blocker: the preview dev server sends Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin, so embed.js cannot load on an external site (francemann.com).

minor.issue: A name made only of spaces ('   ') passes min_length=1, is then stripped and saved as an empty name. Strip before validating, or reject blank names.
An agent reply on a closed conversation sets status=open but leaves closed_at in place and posts no 'reopen' system message, so the visitor widget still treats the chat as closed.
The sort key `v['last_seen'] and -timestamp` mixes str and float if last_seen is ever empty, which would raise a TypeError. Low risk today.

ui_bugs.component: Embed script (public/embed.js) on an external site
ui_bugs.issue: The preview frontend serves every file with 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin' (craco.config.js devServer headers), so <script src=.../embed.js> on another origin fails with net::ERR_BLOCKED_BY_RESPONSE.NotSameOrigin and the widget never appears. With the header stripped in a test, the iframe embed works fully (open/close resize, prechat, thread). Confirm the production host does not send this header, or serve embed.js with 'Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin', for example from a backend /api/embed.js route.

ui_bugs.component: Admin-only routes for the agent role
ui_bugs.issue: An agent who opens /analytics, /team or /settings directly sees the empty page shell plus an error toast. There is no route guard or redirect (the nav is hidden correctly).

A stale custom error stays on screen: after 'Please enter your name.' appears and the name is then filled in, the browser's own email check blocks submit and the old name error is still shown. Clear prechat-error when inputs change, and use one validation path (custom or native).

issues: The Products/Samples/Contact nav links are hidden on mobile and there is no menu button to reach them. Only 'Support team login' is shown.

The iframe is 420px wide, below the sm breakpoint, so the widget uses the mobile full-bleed layout: the panel sits flush against the right and bottom edges with no rounded card and no launcher button. Size the iframe as panel plus margin, or switch layout based on a parent-supplied flag instead of the iframe width.
The commodity picker is a native <select>, not the shadcn Select used in the dashboard. This is minor visual inconsistency.
The 'Country' row shows 'City, Country (CC)'. Label it 'Location'.

action_items: HIGH: make embed.js loadable cross-origin (the CORP same-origin header blocks it on francemann.com). Verify on the production host, or serve it from the backend with Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: cross-origin.
Reject blank or whitespace-only visitor names in IdentifyIn.
When an agent replies on a closed conversation, reopen it properly (clear closed_at, post a reopen system message) or block the reply.
Add a role guard on /analytics, /team and /settings for non-admins.
Clear the stale prechat-error when inputs change.
Add a mobile nav menu to the public site, and adjust the widget layout inside the embed iframe.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 647 lines and close to the 700-line limit. Consider splitting the routes into widget, staff and admin modules.

run_automation sends an AI reply even when an agent is online but the chat is unassigned. This matches the design but can race with a human reply. The agent_replied re-check after the LLM call mitigates it.
The visitor WebSocket handler in useVisitorChat deletes the token on close codes 4401/4404 but does not start a new session, so the widget stays on 'Reconnecting...' until the page reloads.
widget/session runs a geo lookup (ip-api.com over HTTP) and creates a new visitor document for every tokenless call, with no rate limit. This is an abuse and DB-growth risk.
The visitor name 'Visitor {1001+count}' comes from count_documents, so concurrent sessions can get the same name. This is cosmetic.

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows pass; the external embed is blocked by the CORP header)

test_credentials: Used admin/agent/pending +clerk_test users from /app/memory/test_credentials.md through Clerk sign-in tickets (UI) and session tokens (API). clerk_helper.py reads CLERK_SECRET_KEY with dotenv and never prints it.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed visitors and conversations (TEST_Keyword, TEST_AI, TEST_End, TEST_Assign, TEST_WS, TEST_Offline, TEST_UIVisitor, TEST_RealtimeVisitor, TEST_AssignVisitor, TEST_EmbedVisitor, plus one blank-name visitor from the whitespace test). There is no delete API for visitors or conversations, so they remain. Settings were round-tripped and restored, and agent/admin status was set back to online. No role was changed (the last-admin demotion was correctly rejected with 409).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests serially: cd /app/backend/tests && python -m pytest test_franceman_chat.py -n 0 -v. Get Clerk tickets with `python clerk_helper.py ticket admin|agent|pending` (single use) and open /sign-in?__clerk_ticket=<t>. On mobile the visible UserButton is the second .cl-userButtonTrigger (use :visible), and visitor-details-panel exists twice (desktop xl column plus mobile sheet). To test the external embed, route a fake origin with page.route and strip the CORP header from embed.js.
